copy.tagline_en: Manage multi-chain lending, borrowing, and liquidations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle lending, borrowing, and risk management across chains

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，Claude 可以教你使用 Aave 进行存款赚利息、抵押借款、监控清算风险，并解释健康因子、E-Mode 等概念。
howto.when: 当你说到“Aave”、“存款”、“借款”、“清算”、“健康因子”等关键词，或者询问如何管理 Aave 上的仓位时，Claude 会进入 Aave 助手模式。

say.text: 如何在 Aave 上存款赚利息？
say.note: Claude 会解释存款流程和 aTokens。

say.text: 我的健康因子太低怎么办？
say.note: Claude 会建议加抵押或还款来提高健康因子。

say.text: Aave 的清算机制是怎样的？
say.note: Claude 会说明清算触发条件和惩罚比例。

howto.what_en: When this skill is active, Claude helps you lend, borrow, monitor liquidations, and manage risk on Aave across chains. It explains health factor, E-Mode, GHO, and common mistakes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "Aave", "lend", "borrow", "liquidation", "health factor", or ask about managing Aave positions.

say_en.text: How do I deposit on Aave to earn interest?
say_en.note: Claude explains deposit process and aTokens.

say_en.text: My health factor is low, what should I do?
say_en.note: Claude suggests adding collateral or repaying debt.
Claude explains trigger condition and penalty.
